name: Breadcrumbs
hint: Drag the box's corner narrower: the middle folds into a … menu, one level at a time.
description: A location trail that truncates by meaning. As space runs out, middle levels fold into a … menu one at a time, always keeping the root and the levels nearest the current page; the current page is ellipsised only as a last resort. Crumbs slide to their new positions instead of jumping.
intents: show where the user is in a hierarchy
usage: Use on pages three or more levels deep. Pass `items` ({ label, href, icon? }, root first, current page last); the last item is the current page and is not a link. With a client-side router pass `linkAs={Link}` (it receives href, to, className, onClick and children) or `renderLink(item, props)`, and `onNavigate` so levels picked from the … menu route too. The trail folds its middle to fit its container; `maxItems` also caps how many crumbs show. Don't use breadcrumbs as the only navigation.

keyboard.does: Moves through the linked crumbs and the … button; the current page is not a Tab stop.
Opens the menu of folded levels and focuses its first level.
Moves to the next or previous folded level.
Moves to the first or last folded level.
Goes to the focused level and closes the menu.
Closes the menu and returns focus to the … button.

screenReader: A nav landmark named by `ariaLabel` ("Breadcrumb" by default) holding an ordered list; the last crumb carries aria-current="page" and the separators are hidden. The … button is named "Show N hidden levels" and reports aria-haspopup="menu" and aria-expanded; the folded levels open as a menu of menu items, and a polite live region names the level picked from it.

dataProps.type: Array<{ label: node; href?: string; onClick?: (event: MouseEvent | null, item: { label: node; href?: string; icon?: string | node; disabled?: boolean }, index: number) => void; icon?: string | node; disabled?: boolean }>
dataProps.description: The path, root first: [{ label, href?, onClick?, icon?, disabled? }]. The last item is the current page (aria-current="page", never a link). onClick is (event, item, index). An item without href renders as a button. icon is an icon name or a node. Empty renders nothing.
Most crumbs shown before the middle folds into the … menu (root and the levels nearest the current page stay). 0 = fold only when out of room.
Component rendered for linked crumbs instead of <a>, e.g. your router's Link. Receives href, to (same value), className, onClick and children.

dataProps.type: (item: { label: node; href?: string; onClick?: (event: MouseEvent | null, item: { label: node; href?: string; icon?: string | node; disabled?: boolean }, index: number) => void; icon?: string | node; disabled?: boolean }, props: { href?: string; className: string; onClick: (event: MouseEvent) => void; children: node }, index: number) => node
dataProps.description: (item, props, index) => node: render a crumb link yourself. Spread props (href, className, onClick, children) onto your link.

dataProps.type: (item: { label: node; href?: string; onClick?: (event: MouseEvent | null, item: { label: node; href?: string; icon?: string | node; disabled?: boolean }, index: number) => void; icon?: string | node; disabled?: boolean }, index: number, event: MouseEvent | null) => void
dataProps.description: (item, index, event) => void when a crumb is clicked or picked from the … menu. For menu picks event is null; without onNavigate or an item onClick the menu follows the item's href.
Controlled: whether the … menu of folded levels is open (only shows while something is folded). Pass with onOpenChange.
(open: boolean) => void when the … menu opens or closes.
Accessible name of the nav landmark.
Any other attribute (id, aria-*, data-*) goes to the root <div>. className and style are merged with the component's own.

example:
<Breadcrumbs
  items={[
    { label: "Acme", href: "/", icon: "home" },
    { label: "Projects", href: "/projects" },
    { label: "Website", href: "/projects/website" },
    { label: "Launch plan" },
  ]}
  linkAs={Link}
  onNavigate={(item) => navigate(item.href)}
  maxItems={4}
/>
